about_the_game:
Freefall '95 is a fast-paced, arcade-like, falling-from-the-sky simulator where you take on the role of the sole survivor of a mid-air disaster as they plummet towards the earth. While falling you can combine radical tricks, dangerous stunts and collect falling items to build up huge scores all while dodging dangerous debris and other hazards.

While on the plane, you can interact with fellow passengers, buy useful items with your hard-earned coins and take on quests to discover what might be causing this aviation nightmare.

Inspired by games like Tony Hawk's Pro Skater, SSX Tricky and other classic extreme sports games, it takes the player back with a heavily '90s-flavoured art style and soundtrack.

Features

  • 5 varied levels, each with unique special items, landing locations and hazards

  • A deep combo system that allows for HUGE scores

  • Arcade-like leaderboard with friends-only and worldwide options

  • A rich, time-bending narrative

  • Ability items that allow the player to explore and experience levels in wild new ways

Freefall '95 Is set to release in March 2026.

content_descriptors.notes:
Pixel-art blood when a player hits a hazard.

Players can drink champagne and become "drunk" momentarily.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any OpenGL 3.3-compatible GPU (512 MB VRAM)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Verified to run smoothly on Steam Deck (native 1280×800).
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 3 or newer
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 / Vulkan capable GPU (1 GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Plays flawlessly on Deck and other low-power devices

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later

  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Runs fine under Rosetta or natively on Apple Silicon

short_description: Fast paced, arcade-like, 90’s inspired action packed fun! Play as a passenger on board a doomed flight stuck in a twisted time loop in the year 1995. Explore a wild time-bending narrative while stacking up trick combos, collecting items, earning coins, upgrading abilities and dodging debris!
